Cost sensitivity: moderate — prefer hosted initially, move to Dedicated for predictable unit economics if runtime shows >$X/token cost at scale.
Model preferences: open models with quantized variants supported; want ability to pin model versions and fallback routing for capacity constraints.
Routing: region-aware routing (primary us-east), fallback to cheaper model variant in second region; require explicit routing policy for fallbacks.
